question: Z jadierka jablka Golden Delicious vám nevyrastie strom s rovnakými jablkami. Ako sa teda táto odroda dostala z jediného stromu v Amerike do sadov po celom svete?
source_excerpt: Golden Delicious most likely began as a chance seedling... Mullins sold the tree and its propagation rights to Stark Brothers Nurseries for $5,000.

extra.why_interesting: Players assume an apple variety reproduces like any plant, from its seeds. In fact a planted pip gives a genetically different tree, so every Golden Delicious they've bought in a Slovak supermarket comes from a clone of one American tree, spread purely by grafting.
extra.verification_notes: Golden Delicious arose as a single chance seedling in Clay County, West Virginia, and was multiplied by Stark Bros. nurseries; apple cultivars are propagated by grafting, so 'štepením' is correct.

explanation: Každý strom Golden Delicious na svete je vlastne klonom jedného náhodného semenáčika zo Západnej Virgínie. Vetvičky z neho sa štepia na podpníky už vyše sto rokov.

question: V záhradách vídate kmene ovocných stromov natreté nabielo vápnom. Nejde hlavne o škodcov. Pred čím ich ten biely náter v zime najmä chráni?
source_excerpt: Bark burnt by the sun splits and cracks on the side facing the midday and afternoon sun direction, when the sun is hottest and most intense.

extra.why_interesting: Every Slovak has seen whitewashed trunks in village gardens and usually assumes it is against pests or just tradition. The real main enemy is the winter sun, which surprises people because sun is not something they associate with winter damage.
extra.verification_notes: Extension sources confirm whitewash mainly protects trunks from winter sun (sunscald and the resulting frost cracks); see https://www.gov.mb.ca/agriculture/crops/plant-diseases/print,winter-sunscald-frost-cracking.html. Alternative answer 'frost cracks' is the same mechanism.

explanation: Na mrazivom slnku sa tmavá kôra cez deň zohreje a v noci prudko premrzne, takže praská. Biela farba slnečné lúče odrazí a kmeň ostane rovnomerne studený.
